CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_learning_path (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    course_id UUID NOT NULL,
    goal_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    curriculum_revision VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    policy_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    planner_policy_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    reason_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    reason_summary VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 1),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= created_at)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_learning_path_item (
    student_learning_path_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES student_learning_path(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    reference_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
    reference_id UUID NOT NULL,
    position INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (position >= 0),
    status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PLANNED','READY','IN_PROGRESS','COMPLETED','SKIPPED_MASTERED')),
    targets_json JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb CHECK (jsonb_typeof(targets_json) = 'array'),
    reason_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (student_learning_path_id, position),
    UNIQUE (student_learning_path_id, reference_type, reference_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_learning_path_revision (
    student_learning_path_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES student_learning_path(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    version BIGINT NOT NULL,
    snapshot_json JSONB NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(snapshot_json) = 'object'),
    reason_code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    reason_summary VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (student_learning_path_id, version)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_diagnostic_snapshot (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id UUID NOT NULL,
    assessment_id UUID NOT NULL,
    curriculum_revision VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    policy_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    items_json JSONB NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(items_json) = 'array'),
    completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (student_id, assessment_id, curriculum_revision)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_diagnostic_snapshot_recent
    ON student_diagnostic_snapshot (student_id, completed_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_learning_session (
    id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id UUID NOT NULL,
    goal VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    course_id UUID,
    lesson_id UUID,
    task_id UUID,
    analytics_session_id UUID,
    active_learning_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (active_learning_seconds >= 0),
    lesson_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (lesson_count >= 0),
    task_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (task_count >= 0),
    question_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (question_count >= 0),
    hint_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (hint_count >= 0),
    teacher_intervention_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (teacher_intervention_count >= 0),
    schema_version VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 1),
    started_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    ended_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_learning_session_interval CHECK (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= started_at),
    CONSTRAINT ck_student_learning_session_updated CHECK (updated_at >= started_at)
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_student_learning_session_active
    ON student_learning_session (student_id) WHERE ended_at IS NULL;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_learning_session_recent
    ON student_learning_session (student_id, started_at DESC);
